{"metadata":{"description":"Context folding for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): wrap work in named tasks, fold finished spans into short summaries, recall originals on demand.","id":"gh:1354524531","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"taskfold","slug":"yindf/taskfold","topics":["agent-memory","ai-agents","coding-agent","compaction","context-management","context-window","cordis","deepseek-harness","developer-tools","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","llm","prompt-caching","token-optimization","typescript"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Context folding for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): wrap work in named tasks, fold finished spans into short"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" summaries, recall originals on demand."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"effectively infinite context for your coding agent"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"简体中文 ·
Releases ·
Changelog"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Keep long AI coding sessions fast, cheap, and readable: finished work is folded into a short summary"},{"id":"p4s2","text":", and the full original content is always one call away."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"For DeepSeek Harness (DSH)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> **Latest supported dsh: `0.2.1-rc.5`.** dsh rc builds are supported on this branch; dsh alpha buil"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ds are supported on the `alpha` branch."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Quickstart"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### Install in dsh Desktop (recommended)"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"1. Open dsh Desktop and go to the **Plugins** page in the sidebar.
2. Click **Add plugin** in the to"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"p-right corner.
3. In **Package name or address**, enter `dsh-taskfold` — the dialog runs pnpm for y"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ou:
- **want the newest release the moment it ships?** pin it — `dsh-taskfold@<version>` from the ve"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"rsions list. pnpm 11 (bundled with dsh Desktop) leaves a release younger than 24 h out of the bare n"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"ame's reach, and an explicit version overrides that; pnpm records it in the profile's `minimumReleas"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"eAgeExclude` too. Never install **0.37.7** or **0.38.0** — uninstallable (`ERR_PNPM_LINKED_PKG_DIR_N"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"OT_FOUND`) and deprecated on npm;
- **skip npm entirely:** paste the prebuilt `.tgz` from the newest"},{"id":"p9s8","text":" Release — a tarball is not subject to the release-age policy;
- **follow a branch:** `github:yindf/"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"taskfold#master` (rc channel) or `github:yindf/taskfold#alpha` (alpha channel) — needs direct GitHub"},{"id":"p9s10","text":" access from this machine;
- a **local path** must point at a *copy*, never at your working checkout"},{"id":"p9s11","text":": the plugin manager treats whatever it installs as its own (it leaves `dsh-taskfold.frozen-*.bak` s"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"napshots beside it and replaces the directory on upgrade).
4. Leave **Registry** on **Default regist"},{"id":"p9s13","text":"ry**; mainland-China networks can pick **Mainland China mirror** and retry.
5. Click **Install**, wa"},{"id":"p9s14","text":"it for "Installed; it loads at the next start.", then click **Enable now**.
6. **Restart dsh Desktop"},{"id":"p9s15","text":"** — plugin composition is evaluated only at startup. Back on the Plugins page you should see a **Ta"},{"id":"p9s16","text":"skfold** card reading *Components · 2 total · 2 running* (`taskfold` and `taskfold-client`); the fol"},{"id":"p9s17","text":"d floor and the task-bar switch live on that card (see Settings).
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Why you want it"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Long sessions drown in their own history: every request re-sends hours of finished work — old tool o"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"utputs, debug logs, abandoned attempts. Costs climb, the model gets distracted, and eventually the c"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ontext window fills up."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"taskfold fixes this the way a good notebook does. While working, the agent wraps each task with `tas"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"k_begin("fix the login bug")`. When the task is done, `task_end` closes it **and** replaces the enti"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"re back-and-forth with a short titled summary:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The conversation stays readable, every request gets cheaper, and the model keeps the *lessons* witho"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ut dragging the *transcript* along."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"**Nothing is lost.** Every fold saves the exact original messages to a file, and `fold_recall({ fold"},{"id":"p15s2","text":": N })` can regenerate it at any time. Fold first, look later — like closing a book you can reopen."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## How it works (plain words)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **Named tasks.** The agent opens a task before starting work and closes it when done. Open tasks s"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"urvive restarts; closing is well-ordered (innermost first), and a failed close never corrupts anythi"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ng — just retry.
- **Folding = closing + summarizing in one call.** The summary is written once, whi"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"le the original span is still in context, so it's accurate — not a "summary of a summary".
- **Summa"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"ries keep what matters.** The summarizer is instructed to preserve user decisions and feedback (verb"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"atim where wording matters), pitfalls and *why* things failed, what changed, and the outcome.
- **Ge"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"ntle guardrails.** If the agent forgets the discipline, a short hint appears in its context. Hints a"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"re events, not state: one is published only when the condition appears or its wording changes, nothi"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"ng is published once the condition clears (the model already complied and does not need to be told),"},{"id":"p17s10","text":" and there is no wrapper, supersession header, or expiry notice — no noise when the flow is healthy."},{"id":"p17s11","text":"
- **Cheap on the cache.** Folding only rewrites a middle chunk of history; the stable prefix (syste"},{"id":"p17s12","text":"m prompt, tools, earlier context) stays cache-friendly."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## What it saves (measured)"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"One real session — 411 model steps, 26 folds — read from the harness's own usage records:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| | Without folding | With taskfold |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Total prompt tokens | 142,654,308 | 52,127,098 (**−63.5%**) |
| Largest single request | 594,909 |"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" 206,896 (−65%) |
| Context window used at peak | 59.5% | 20.7% |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The mechanism: folding moved **441,100 tokens** of finished work off the surface. Because that histo"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ry would otherwise be re-sent on every later request, it added up to **90,527,210 tokens never sent*"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"*. Producing the 26 summaries cost 3,550,270 tokens (3.9% of the saving, and most of it cache reads)"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"; the biggest single fold took 40,422 tokens out of the conversation in one call."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Most of those tokens would have been cache *reads* rather than fresh input — cheaper, but still bill"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ed and still occupying the window. In longer sessions that is the difference between staying inside "},{"id":"p23s3","text":"the context window and not."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"One session, one task shape — your numbers will differ. The mechanism is the point: finished work le"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"aves the surface, the stable prefix stays cached, and the model keeps the lessons instead of the tra"},{"id":"p24s3","text":" surface, the stable prefix stays cached, and the model keeps the lessons instead of the transcript."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## What it adds"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Four agent tools (plus the reminders above):"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| Tool | One-liner |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| `task_begin({ name })` | Open a named task. |
| `task_end({ name })` | Close it and fold its whole"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" span into one titled summary. |
| `list_folds` | List all folds (number, size, title). |
| `fold_re"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"call({ fold })` | Bring back any fold's original content on demand. |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"In the Web GUI, the current open-task stack can also show as a live dock above the composer (like th"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"e todo panel) — hidden by default, switched on with `showTaskBar` on the Plugins page: outermost fir"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"st, the innermost task highlighted, with the closing/pending counts — read straight from the session"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"'s `taskMarks` projection, no extra events."}],"truncated":true}
